name: jev-api
description: Registers the TypeSafe Jev System One question types noul, choice and score as tools, plus batch for several questions in one request; configured by TYPESAFE_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_BASE_URL or JEV_URL.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: HTTP timeout of one System One request in seconds, at most 30, used when a tool call gives no valid timeout of its own (invalid or unset: 20).
